title: Blueprint approval: state before and after run, approve and reject
Reject dialog for a ticket approval: reason is optional and Reject is always enabled
notes: Field labelled "Comment (optional)". Requirement PA-ACT-2: a reason of 3 to 2000 characters is required.
Reject stays enabled when the box is empty, has 2 characters or only spaces.
API also accepts it: reject with no comment, null, "", "ab" or spaces -> 200 and the request is rejected. Bulk reject and on-behalf reject do require 3 to 2000 characters.
